sponsored.t: Relates to notice of transfer of sex offender to community program or residence
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice of transfer of sex offender to community program or residence.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Clara H. Barton
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the village of Dansville, county of Livingston, to Clara H. Barton.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in photovoltaic modules
sponsored.sum: Provides that on and after January 1, 2028, no person shall sell, offer for sale or manufacture in this state any photovoltaic modules containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances as intentionally added chemicals.

sponsored.t: Gives state residents reservation preference for state parks and recreational facilities
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Gives state residents reservation preference for state parks and recreational facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing state correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing state correction officers with a special optional twenty year retirement plan.

sponsored.t: Provides an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for 911 operators
sponsored.sum: Provides an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for county 911 operators throughout the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to school safety measures
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state school resource officer program; provides for grants for school resource officers (Part A); relates to peace officers who are retired police officers employed by a school district as a school resource officer (Part B); allows retired police officers to be employed by a school district as a school safety officer, school security officer or any other substantially similar position for an annual salary of $50,000 or less to continue to receive their full retirement benefit (Part C).

sponsored.t: Relates to the Finger Lakes Crematory
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Finger Lakes crematory located in the village of Livonia, county of Livingston may add an additional retort expressly and for use in an instance of mechanical or technical failure of an existing retort.

sponsored.t: Defines the term crossbow
sponsored.sum: Defines the term crossbow as a bow and string, either compound or recurve, that launches a bolt or arrow, mounted upon a stock with a trigger that holds the string and limbs under tension until released which shall have at least six inches of limb width.

sponsored.t: Relates to national instant criminal background checks and ammunition; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes ammunition and ammunition sales from the requirements of background checks; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto; repeals the background check fund.

sponsored.t: Creates a quarterly advance payment schedule for the farm employer overtime tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates a quarterly advance payment schedule for the farm employer overtime tax credit.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the exercise of jurisdiction over commercial claims in justice courts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes justice courts to exercise jurisdiction over commercial claims arising out of a transaction between a claimant and a natural person, wherein the money, property or service which is the subject of the transaction is primarily for personal, family or household purposes.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of aggravated forcible touching by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of aggravated forcible touching by an incarcerated individual as a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "responsible renewable energy recycling act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "responsible renewable energy recycling act" to require manufacturers of solar panels, wind turbines, and batteries to collect such materials when they are taken out of use; requires educational outreach relating thereto; establishes collection goals therefor; requires reporting of collection efforts.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the "Farmland for a New Generation" program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of the "Farmland for a New Generation" program.

sponsored.t: Protects women's sports from unfair competition
sponsored.sum: Protects women's sports in middle school and high school from unfair competition.

sponsored.t: Allows for certain members of a public retirement system of the state to receive credit for military service
sponsored.sum: Allows members of a public retirement system who retired prior to applying for credit for military service because such credit was not available at the time of their retirement to receive such credit if they apply prior to December 31, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to background checks for volunteer and paid firefighters
sponsored.sum: Authorizes any prospective employer of a volunteer firefighter or paid firefighter to perform a background check on such applicant.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law authorizing the county of Livingston to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law authorizing the county of Livingston to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to sales and compensating use taxes in the county of Livingston
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Livingston to impose an additional one percent sales tax.
